fields.label: Enable neural rendering
fields.help: Master switch for the neural pass. DLAA can still run when this is off.

fields.label: Overall strength
fields.help: How strongly the neural result changes the original frame. Start below 1 for a restrained look.

fields.label: Tone strength
fields.help: Model control for local lighting and tonal changes.

fields.label: Detail strength
fields.help: Model control for structure and surface detail. High values can exaggerate texture.

fields.label: Skin / character detail
fields.help: -1 uses the model default. Higher values request more skin detail; results depend on the scene and masking.

fields.label: Color strength
fields.help: How much of the model's color change is composed into the frame.

fields.label: Automatic character mask
fields.help: Ask the model to infer its character mask. This is not a guaranteed face or HUD protector.

fields.label: Model style
fields.help: Select a model style. These are the bundled consumer's settings; look presets above are separate starting values.

fields.label: Model resolution
fields.help: Run the neural model at 50-100% of each axis. Lower values can reduce GPU cost and fine detail; the game's output resolution stays the same.

fields.label: Neural passes
fields.help: More neural passes stack edits and increase GPU cost. One pass is the recommended starting point.

fields.label: Chained pass history
fields.help: Use the consumer's chained-history mode for multipass rendering. Turn off if comparing temporal behavior.

fields.label: Model preset
fields.help: NGX render-preset hint, not a game genre or a named look. The runtime may treat some hints alike.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.description: The bundled model's starting values, with one pass at full resolution.

presets.name: Subtle
presets.description: Smaller lighting, texture, and color changes.

presets.name: Characters / story
presets.description: Restrained surface detail and inferred character masking. A starting look for character-heavy scenes.

presets.name: Scenery / racing
presets.description: More environment detail with moderate color changes.

presets.name: Fast action
presets.description: One pass at 75% model resolution, with restrained edits. Compare frame rate and detail in your game.
